scripts.test: tsx --test $(find tests extensions -type f -name '*.test.ts' -print 2>/dev/null) && node --test tests/manifest.test.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json tsconfig.json 'extensions/**/*.ts' 'lib/**/*.ts' 'tests/**/*.{ts,mjs}' 'scripts/**/*.mjs' skills/grill-me/SKILL.md skills/thinking-partner/SKILL.md skills/handoff/SKILL.md 'themes/*.json' README.md THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md
scripts.verify:skills: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; : "${PI_SKILL_TEST_MODEL:?PI_SKILL_TEST_MODEL=<provider>/<model> is required}"; output_root=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/pi-skill-behavior.XXXXXX"); trap "rm -rf \"$output_root\"" EXIT; if tsx tests/skill-behavior.ts --mode baseline --output "$output_root/baseline"; then echo "baseline unexpectedly discovered one or more skills" >&2; exit 1; fi; tsx tests/skill-behavior.ts --mode package --package "$PWD" --output "$output_root/package"'
